items.summary: Reject the proposed therareunicorn.com change request: low telemetry, incomplete attribution, and uncleared queue and security gates do not support production or financial claims. Preserve existing repair, measurement, attribution, legal, and security work; do not create new implementation, deployment, spend, telemetry, monetization, experiment, or requeue work. Owner concern: the recorded $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable, so revenue, ROI, margin, payback, and causal lift remain unknown.

Material concerns: attribution is partial, revenue and cost periods are misaligned, telemetry is low or absent for the proposed site, and security and operations evidence remains incomplete. Keep public and security-sensitive launch gates closed and keep external permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review. The only retained new work is one bounded public inspection to document observable positioning, disclosures, conversion paths, launch-scope unknowns, and exactly one evidence-based disposition; it must not change production or telemetry.

Reject the requested new implementation batch. No candidate is safely queueable: active measurement, failure-repair, ownership, release, attribution, and security gates remain open. Revenue, ROI, margin, payback, and causal lift remain unknown; the aggregate commission is unattributed. Continue existing repair, reconciliation, legal, security, and measurement work only. Preserve one bounded public inspection for therareunicorn.com; do not deploy, requeue, add telemetry, spend, change credentials, or alter launch gates.

Reject all new implementation queue work this cycle. The mandate cannot be satisfied without violating existing containment decisions: no candidate is unblocked by the authoritative snapshot. Retain SEO, UX, affiliate, site-factory, and CRO opportunities as deferred backlog and continue only existing repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, legal evidence, security evidence, and measurement work.
